section.27: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives

27.name_native: Chapters on Righteousness And Maintaining Good Relations With Relatives

hadiths.text: Ibn 'Abbas narrated:"The Messenger of Allah sent Mu'adh [bin Jabal] to Yemen, and said: 'Beware of the supplication of the oppressed; for indeed there is no barrier between it and Allah
